Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options & sample payloads

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As CloudBridge gets set up in Redwood's vendor portal I wanted to confirm how you prefer we send invoices once we go live. A couple of specific questions so we format things correctly: 

- Which intake channel do you prefer for recurring invoices: portal upload, SFTP, or email to AP?
- If email, does Redwood require PO stamping (i.e., PO number on the PDF itself) or is PO in the subject line sufficient?
- Do you accept CSV batches (one row per invoice) or do you need a separate PDF per invoice? If CSV is acceptable, what are the required fields?
- Any file-naming conventions or metadata headers we should follow?

Attached are two example payloads: sample_invoice.pdf (single invoice PDF) and sample_csv_rows.csv (two-row CSV showing our current fields). We want to avoid resubmits and ensure matching to POs on first pass.

Thanks,
Anna Morales

Hi Anna —

Appreciate the examples. High-level guidance from Redwood for most vendors:

- Portal preferred for recurring/volume billing (best for tracking and automated matching).
- Email to invoices@redwood.com is accepted for low-volume or one-off invoices; please put the PO number in the subject line (e.g., "PO 12345 - CloudBridge Invoice"). We can accept the PO in-subject + PDF.
- CSV batches are fine for bulk uploads but must follow our schema (one row per invoice). If you plan to send CSV, please use the schema Marissa will confirm below.
- File naming: include vendor name + invoice date + PO (e.g., CloudBridge_20260501_PO12345.pdf).

Marissa — would you confirm the CSV required columns and whether AP requires the PO stamped on the PDF itself for automated matching? Monica is copied for vendor onboarding ops.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi Anna, Sean —

Confirmed from AP side and adding the acceptance criteria so CloudBridge can validate before sending the first batch: 

Acceptance & matching rules
- Preferred: vendor portal (uploads create a tracked ticket and automatic PO-match attempts).
- Email: invoices@redwood.com is accepted for smaller volumes. SUBJECT must include PO number (exact match, numeric only). Example: "PO 98765 - CloudBridge Invoice".
- PDF rules: a single PDF per invoice is required for PDF submissions. Multi-invoice PDFs are reviewed manually and slow down processing.
- CSV rules: CSVs must be UTF-8, comma delimited, one invoice per row. Required columns: vendor_id, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount, currency (USD), po_number, line_description. Optional: tax_amount, tax_id.
- File names: vendorName_YYYYMMDD_PO#####.ext; avoid spaces.

SLA & confirmations
- Acknowledgement (auto or manual): within 1 business day for portal uploads; within 1 business day for email submissions if subject and attachments are correct.
- Rejection/resubmit reason will include a short code and description (e.g., MISSING_PO, AMOUNT_MISMATCH).

Exceptions
- If you need SFTP for nightly batch drops, we can provision access (lead time ~5 business days).
- For early partner pilots we sometimes allow CSV single file with multiple rows; but please coordinate before sending.

I attached invoice_schema_v1.csv — please use that as your mapping. If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute run-through to validate your CSV-to-schema mapping before you send a full batch.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Procure-to-Pay, Redwood Inference
